distributionType: Complete pinned upstream tracked source snapshot, including post-0.21.0 fixes; Git metadata omitted.
runtimeOverlay: scripts/prepare-izlauncher.cjs creates a separate Mac IZlauncher runtime with File Exchange, File Exchange FS, Book Reader, pinned BlitBun and VacooTube adaptations, an offline shader compiler and precompiled shell variants from this pinned snapshot. The legacy IZMYSH host profile launches separately preserved source for its NS2I bootstrap.
scope: IZlauncher on an existing verified held RPC session. The pinned v0.16 IZMYSH host and NS2I bootstrap remain separate under vendor/ns2jb-hosts/izmysh-legacy; IZ2S 0.21's NS2IZM bootstrap is included as source but is not selected by mac2jb. IZPSlauncher source is bundled but not started by mac2jb.

validation: Offline packaging and fixture checks do not establish physical console compatibility.
